title: Validate multiple generations of recursive improvement
goal: Run at least three successive candidate generations on a fixed held-out suite with unchanged gates; publish each generation's deltas, budget, and rejection history and stop on non-improvement or regression. Deps (vectors): VC-201-010, VC-201-014, VC-201-018, VC-201-019. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_020_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
